audience: vacation rental hosts and managers who run bookings and channels in Hosthub

useCases.title: See the bookings of each rental
useCases.text: List the rentals on the account. List the calendar events of one rental or of all rentals, and open one event for its dates and guest details.

useCases.title: Review the channels and rates of a rental
useCases.text: List the sales channels connected to one rental. Read the rate plans and the price per night for each date the API holds.

useCases.title: Look up users and team members
useCases.text: List the users and team members of the account with their roles. Open one user for contact details and status.

useCases.title: Read the internal notes of a booking
useCases.text: Open one calendar event, then list its internal notes.

useCases.title: Block a rental for repairs
useCases.text: Create a hold to block the dates of one rental, for example for repairs. A hold needs a reason. The change affects live availability on every connected channel.

useCases.title: Change or delete a booking
useCases.text: Change the dates or guest details of a booking, or delete a booking or hold. Only the fields you pass change. Both actions can change availability on connected channels.
